name: Solomon USDv
oneLiner: USDV is Solomon Labs's synthetic dollar on Solana backed by Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral perp margin, with no permissionless public redemption rail.
collateral: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin used by Solomon Labs to back USDv
pegMechanism: USDv targets $1 through Solomon-managed strategy collateral, market liquidity, and approved/whitelisted participant redemption into USDC against a small documented protocol reserve buffer; no permissionless public holder redemption rail is disclosed

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Solomon's official launch history says USDv operated through a year-long live beta before its November 2025 public introduction, and describes the yield engine as a spot-long, perpetual-short basis trade across major cryptoassets. The issuer's current site independently describes USDv as operating live since late 2024 across Treasuries and delta-neutral strategies, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral classification and a conservative Q4 2024 implementation date, stored at its range end (2024-12).

sources.label: Solomon official introduction and year-long beta disclosure

oracleRisk.summary: USDv is issued against Solomon-managed custody assets and delta-neutral hedge positions rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: Solomon documents minting and redemption by approved entities, followed by protocol-managed off-exchange custody and derivative hedging. The reviewed issuer material does not describe borrower-specific debt positions, collateral-ratio thresholds, or liquidatable collateral branches for USDv issuance.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 at finalized Solana slot 438054830. USDv is an 82-byte legacy SPL Token mint owned by Tokenkeg and its freezeAuthority option is zero. The pinned Tokenkeg processor requires holder/delegate authorization for transfers and a current freeze authority for account freezes; a disabled freeze authority cannot be restored. Solomon's current Terms describe Solomon as an interface-only, non-custodial operator that cannot sign or cause user transactions and disclose interface geofencing/wallet screening rather than a power over already-issued USDv. Reserve-asset issuer controls can impair USDv backing or redemption but cannot freeze a standalone holder's USDv token account, so the direct holder-seizure verdict is No; the dedicated transfer overlay separately records the permissionless current transfer logic.

reserveReview.rationale: Solomon's live protocol-data API (snapshot updated 2026-07-30T00:14:08.307Z, fetched 2026-07-30) reports $395,051.09 of Ceffu-custodied BTC, $2,563.23 of Ceffu-custodied SOL, $81,295.31 of on-chain USDC, $701.37 of USDC in yield distributors, and $17,543.76 of on-chain USDT against protocolTvl of $1,512,045.79, cross-anchored to the on-chain USDv SPL supply of 1,512,045.796506006 read via getAccountInfo at Solana finalized slot 436224996, which matches protocolTvl to within a cent. The identified components cover 32.88% of protocolTvl, so the composition retains an explicit 67.12% unmapped residual instead of normalizing the identified positions to 100%. The API still does not show the USDG or Treasury positions the restructured docs describe as current and planned backing.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer live protocol-data API reserve components measured against protocolTvl $1,512,045.79 at snapshot 2026-07-30T00:14:08.307Z, cross-checked against the on-chain SPL supply at Solana finalized slot 436224996
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: About 67.1% of protocolTvl has no issuer-explained backing allocation in the live API. The API does not reconcile reserve components to protocolTvl; the location and segregation of margin supporting the Binance hedge positions is undisclosed. The latest public Ceffu first-party attestation remains dated 2026-04-01 (verified 2026-07-30 as the newest file in the SolomonLabs/attestations repository), is issued by the custodian rather than an independent auditor, and does not break down composition.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ceffu's first-party attestation states client assets are held fully in Ceffu custody and not at any digital asset exchange, while the live API shows Binance inverse-perpetual shorts, implying off-exchange settlement with margin whose account segregation is undisclosed. The attestation is aggregate, point-in-time (2026-04-01), and not an independent audit.

notices.title: Partial reserve coverage
notices.message: USDv has on-chain supply validation and a live issuer protocol-data API, but the API's reported reserve components covered only about 32.9% of protocolTvl at 2026-07-30; the remaining 67.1% is unmapped. Public Ceffu attestations are aggregate, custodian-issued, and stale (latest 2026-04-01). The modeled redemption backstop is limited to approved/whitelisted participants and a documented 0.5% instant reserve buffer; the live feed validates Solana token supply only, while reserve composition is Ceffu-custodied off-exchange and is not on-chain verifiable.

mintAuthority.summary: USDv is minted by Solomon's own Solana program D4AiKFxj via its Deposit instruction, which CPI-signs SPL mintTo with the program-owned PDA 7XAdHs5Q (the SPL mint authority); the freeze authority is null. Direct mint/redeem is restricted to Solomon-approved entities. The program is BPF-upgradeable and its upgrade authority is a 3-of-9 Squads v4 multisig vault with no timelock, so mint logic can be replaced by that multisig. Backing collateral sits off-chain with Ceffu.

upgradeability.controlRef: Solomon program upgrade authority (Squads v4 3-of-9 multisig vault)

controls.label: USDv SPL mint authority PDA (Solomon mint/redeem program)
controls.evidence: getAccountInfo(Ex5DaKYMCN6QWFA4n67TmMwsH8MJV68RX6YXTmVM532C) at finalized slot 432852804 returns mintAuthority 7XAdHs5QBYaHPwi9Vkj7aSMA4ZzcfazBb8kB2LEPncoa and freezeAuthority null under SPL Token program Tokenkeg. 7XAdHs5Q is a 2960-byte account owned by program D4AiKFxjZBrhd6MeRAAj6wNxFcZJuRMBrXW9UpqeS8Ax whose data holds the USDv mint at offset 8, i.e. it is that program's USDv state and signer PDA, not a keypair and not a Squads multisig. Transaction 3pkubkhwcqzA3ZEt3JAU6R8zYQdUNxA2fZpu2czhaHvRn7p41aoCYPXu7yKzXmYyGebwGBYoJeEFudqBXHqi1GLC (slot 425466328) shows D4AiKFxj 'Instruction: Deposit' CPI-signing SPL mintTo of 1349.73 USDv with mintAuthority 7XAdHs5Q; transaction N2bqJEcC3ZYUTBAQM4qWGBV3dbJmwiMDwnW4f7nsvDM1oAgx5GN2rwEFnwNMK9MH9VusU67ceUuKUEW1b7noGWQ (slot 423727915) shows the same program's 'Instruction: Redeem' burning USDv. No on-chain supply cap constrains an SPL mint authority, so the mint is unbounded.

controls.label: Solomon program upgrade authority (Squads v4 3-of-9 multisig vault)
controls.evidence: At slot 432852804 the BPF-upgradeable programData account 9JWSfaJZ6iVARqkJvbVKCjW5xuy1LaZ3xfWRQmfCEWo2 for program D4AiKFxj reports upgrade authority CSJJKrBP32T71Zqto6hm7Yi8LXd7eBTWn7piFxCjQfsY. CSJJKrBP is System-owned with zero data, but it is not an EOA: it is the Squads v4 vault PDA at index 0 (bump 250) of multisig 71a1tEfnCULkcR1YokJiAt1M8JVMRFhcJPSTf3G3aLX8, reproduced from seeds ['multisig', multisig, 'vault', 0] under program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf, and it CPI-signs a transferChecked inside the Squads VaultTransactionExecute transaction 3HmoZfjjLMGn4VVVPQS4PAgMtVGrAnYKSfnUyyu3GNywwTtxX3uG9mfs137o74A8CA6wCsb7TKw8JUQy75a5jzt6. The multisig account (Anchor discriminator e07479ba44a14fec = account:Multisig, 561 bytes) decodes to threshold 3, nine members each holding Initiate, Vote and Execute permissions, time_lock 0, and config_authority set to the system default, meaning configuration changes are member-governed with no external config owner.

controls.label: Ceffu off-exchange custodian (USDv backing collateral)
controls.evidence: Solomon documents that approved entities mint and redeem USDv against assets moved into Ceffu off-exchange custody backing the delta-neutral position. Ceffu holds no Solana mint or freeze authority: at slot 432852804 the only SPL mint authority is the program PDA 7XAdHs5Q and the freeze authority is null, so this control carries custody risk, not mint capability.

review.evidence: Snapshot at Solana finalized slot 432852804 (getMultipleAccounts, single context slot). USDv mint Ex5DaKYMCN6QWFA4n67TmMwsH8MJV68RX6YXTmVM532C: mintAuthority 7XAdHs5QBYaHPwi9Vkj7aSMA4ZzcfazBb8kB2LEPncoa, freezeAuthority null, supply 1512045.989548996. 7XAdHs5Q is owned by program D4AiKFxjZBrhd6MeRAAj6wNxFcZJuRMBrXW9UpqeS8Ax, which was the prior review's open question: observed mint and burn transactions prove D4AiKFxj is Solomon's USDv mint/redeem program (Deposit CPI mintTo, Redeem CPI burn). D4AiKFxj is BPF-upgradeable via programData 9JWSfaJZ6iVARqkJvbVKCjW5xuy1LaZ3xfWRQmfCEWo2 with upgrade authority CSJJKrBP32T71Zqto6hm7Yi8LXd7eBTWn7piFxCjQfsY, which PDA derivation and a Squads VaultTransactionExecute confirm is vault index 0 of Squads v4 multisig 71a1tEfnCULkcR1YokJiAt1M8JVMRFhcJPSTf3G3aLX8, decoding to threshold 3 of 9 members with time_lock 0. Solomon docs state that approved entities are able to mint and redeem USDv using select assets. Correction to the 2026-06-11 review: the upgrade authority is a 3-of-9 Squads multisig, not an EOA keypair.
